title: apricity serve --link advertises and streams the Link clock; the page can only ping
description:
As a performer using the web app, I want `apricity serve --link` to join the Link session and pass its clock to the page, since a page can't join Link itself.

Spec file: `features/link/serve.feature`, implemented as Rust tests in `crates/apricity-cli/src/serve.rs` (as `features/serve/serve.feature` is) on a `ScriptedSession`, plus `scripts/serve-smoke.sh`. Messages are defined by `schema/link-clock.schema.json`.

```gherkin
Feature: apricity serve passes the Link clock to the web app

  Scenario: amplify_outputs.json says where the clock is
    Given apricity serve runs with --link
    When I GET "/amplify_outputs.json"
    Then custom.apricity.link.url is this server's "/link" WebSocket URL
    Given apricity serve runs without --link
    Then there is no custom.apricity.link

  Scenario: The clock stream
    Given apricity serve runs with --link in a session at 124 BPM with 1 other peer
    When I open a WebSocket to "/link"
    Then the first message is a clock message with tempo 124, the beat at a server time, playing, 1 peer and the quantum
    And every message matches schema/link-clock.schema.json
    And a clock message comes at once when the tempo, start/stop or the peers change, and at least every 250 ms otherwise

  Scenario: Ping for the clock offset
    When I send a ping carrying 123.4
    Then a pong comes back carrying 123.4 and the server time

  Scenario: Messages it doesn't understand
    When I send "hello" or a message whose type is "tempo"
    Then an error message names the problem, such as "unknown message type `tempo`; the page can only ping"
    And the clock stream continues

  Scenario: The page cannot change the session
    Given a session at 124 BPM, playing
    When a page sends any message
    Then the session's tempo and start/stop are unchanged

  Scenario: Link is off
    Given apricity serve runs without --link
    When I open "/link"
    Then the status is 404 and the body says "Link is off; start apricity serve with --link"
```
